name: Sakakibara Tsubasa
source: Tsubasa is often seen as a chill dude, but that’s just part of a facade that even Chinatsu doesn’t see through. Loves cute things and dressing up in girly clothes, and is deeply distressed that it’s all being kept a secret from Chinatsu. Finds uniform optionalization more worrying than anything else, and cares deeply about Chinatsu in earnest.
